chunks: And in the narration of ʿAlī ibn ʿAṭiyyah, from his father, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, he said:
"For the one who has taqwa of Allah, the Mighty and Glorious."

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam عليه السلام from whom the hadith is transmitted
key_terms.اتَّقَى: had taqwa; was God-conscious and guarded against disobedience
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: the Mighty and Glorious; exalted divine honorific
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the one who has taqwa of Allah?
ai.summary: This report attributes a brief statement to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام centered on taqwa toward Allah, the Mighty and Glorious. It emphasizes God-consciousness as the defining quality for the one being referred to in the text.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3018 - In a narration from Ali ibn Atiyyah, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (as), he said:
"For the one who fears Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious."
